screens.title: Know the sample
screens.ask: How many responses can we use for this study?
screens.command: npm run research -- sample "--study=Harbour Coffee subscription"
screens.output:
name                        | currency | price_unit           | imported | eligible | excluded | min_sample
----------------------------|----------|----------------------|----------|----------|----------|-----------
Harbour Coffee subscription | NZD      | monthly subscription | 10       | 8        | 2        | 6
